metadata.description: Lebanese Labor Code (1946), Social Security, and related labor/employment legislation

laws.official_title_arabic: قانون العمل اللبناني الصادر في 23 أيلول 1946

amendments.summary: Amended on various occasions, most recently in May 2025. Key amendments have addressed working hours, maternity leave, minimum wage, child labor, and worker protections.
Set statutory minimum wage at LBP 675,000/month (approximately $450 at pre-crisis exchange rate). This decree implemented wage increases through amendments to the Labor Code.

key_articles.text_english: Scope of application. Applies to employers and employees in commercial, industrial, and agricultural establishments. Excludes public servants, domestic workers (until recent amendments), and agricultural workers (partially).
key_articles.subject: Scope and application

key_articles.text_english: Non-discrimination: prohibition of discrimination in employment on basis of sex (equal pay provisions, though limited in scope).
key_articles.subject: Non-discrimination

key_articles.text_english: Working hours and conditions. Maximum 48 hours per week. Special provisions for hazardous work.
key_articles.subject: Working hours

key_articles.text_english: Maternity leave provisions: pre- and post-natal leave entitlements.
key_articles.subject: Maternity leave

key_articles.text_english: Right to organize and form trade unions. Freedom to unionize or not to unionize.
key_articles.subject: Freedom of association

key_articles.text_english: Termination of employment: end of service indemnity (severance), notice periods, arbitrary dismissal compensation.
key_articles.subject: Termination and severance

laws.historical_context: Enacted after twenty years of intense workers' mobilizations in tobacco, typography, transport, petroleum, and port sectors. Governs private and mixed sector employment. Public sector regulated by separate Decree-Law 112/1959. Notable exclusions historically included domestic workers, agricultural workers, and family businesses. Domestic workers were partially covered by Law No. 41/2024. The Labor Code requires prior authorization from the Ministry of Labour for trade union formation, which has been criticized by ILO committees. Lebanon has ratified most core ILO conventions.

laws.official_title_english: Social Security Act / National Social Security Fund (NSSF) Law

amendments.summary: Began implementation of optional social security in the Sickness and Maternity Branch of NSSF.

key_articles.text_english: Establishment of the National Social Security Fund (NSSF / الصندوق الوطني للضمان الاجتماعي). Three branches: Sickness and Maternity, Family Allowances, End of Service Indemnity.
key_articles.subject: NSSF establishment and branches

key_articles.text_english: Maternity benefits: cash benefits during maternity leave.
key_articles.subject: Maternity benefits

laws.historical_context: Established Lebanon's social security system through the National Social Security Fund (NSSF). Originally planned to have four branches, but only three have been fully implemented: Sickness and Maternity, Family Allowances, and End of Service Indemnity. A retirement/pension branch has never been implemented despite decades of discussion. The NSSF covers employees registered in the private sector. Self-employed persons and informal workers largely remain excluded. The fund has faced severe financial difficulties, particularly since the 2019 economic crisis.

laws.official_title_english: Civil Servants Regulation / Public Employment Law
laws.historical_context: Governs employment of civil servants in the public sector. Separate from the Labor Code which covers private sector. Establishes rights, obligations, disciplinary procedures, and career paths for government employees. Confessional balance requirements apply to public sector appointments under the Constitution.

laws.official_title_arabic: مرسوم اشتراعي رقم 115/59 - إنشاء التفتيش المركزي
laws.historical_context: Established the Central Investigation Office (التفتيش المركزي), an oversight body for public administration. Exercises supervisory control over government ministries and agencies.

laws.official_title_arabic: مرسوم اشتراعي رقم 136/83 - نظام حوادث العمل
laws.historical_context: Regulates work-related accidents and occupational injuries. Applies to both Lebanese and foreign employees. Establishes employer liability for workplace accidents and occupational diseases.

laws.official_title_arabic: مرسوم رقم 3572/1980 - صلاحيات مجالس العمل التحكيمية
laws.official_title_french: Décret No. 3572/1980 - Conseils du Travail Arbitraux
laws.official_title_english: Decree on the Authorities of Arbitration Labour Councils
laws.historical_context: Establishes the labor arbitration council system for resolving labor disputes. Each council consists of a judge (presiding), a workers' representative, and an employers' representative. Decisions can be challenged by objection, third-party objection, and cassation.

laws.official_title_french: Décret No. 17561/1964 - Réglementation du Travail des Étrangers
laws.historical_context: Regulates employment of foreign nationals in Lebanon. Requires work permits and residency permits for legal employment. Sets out permit categories and restrictions by profession. Frequently discussed in the context of Syrian and Palestinian workers in Lebanon.

laws.official_number: Decree No. 11802 of January 30, 2004 (Occupational Safety & Hygiene)
laws.official_title_arabic: مرسوم رقم 11802/2004 - تنظيم الوقاية والسلامة والصحة المهنية
laws.official_title_french: Décret No. 11802/2004 - Prévention, Sécurité et Hygiène Professionnelle
laws.official_title_english: Occupational Prevention, Safety and Hygiene Regulation
laws.historical_context: Comprehensive occupational safety and health regulation implementing the Labor Code. Establishes prevention and safety requirements for all establishments subject to the Labor Code.
